subject: STANDARDIZED_INTEGRATION_FACTORY_AND_PORTABLE_OPERATIONAL_TRUST

risks: Creating a shadow registry before a separate decision and authorization.
Coupling the portable standard to AWS or another provider.
Imposing a global stack without cross-project evidence.
Mixing the SSE test line with the integration-factory migration.
Treating generated, tested or audited artifacts as automatically integrated.
